key.name: update-interval
key.description: How often the network speed display is updated, in seconds (0.5 to 10).

key.name: unit-mode
key.description: Speed unit formatting: 0 = automatic, 1 = KB/s only, 2 = MB/s only.

key.name: show-download
key.description: Whether to display the download speed in the panel.

key.name: show-upload
key.description: Whether to display the upload speed in the panel.
